title: Agentic AI-Powered Electricity Theft Detection Using Temporal Convolution Networks and Context-Aware Reasoning
summary: A hybrid framework using Temporal Convolutional Networks to analyze smart-meter time-series data, with a context-aware module that uses historical and seasonal patterns to reduce false positives and produce accurate theft-risk predictions.

title: An Agentic AI Framework for Dynamic Data Fusion in Flood Forecasting
summary: A multi-agent system using an LLM to fuse LSTM, DeepLabv3+, and DistilBERT outputs across time-series, satellite, and social-media data, dynamically reweighting each model by performance — achieving 93.5% accuracy and 0.96 AUC-ROC, a 3% improvement over static averaging.
